label: Teltonika TRM500
description: Industrial 5G Cat 19 modem: USB Type-C only, no Ethernet port.
notes: Vendor figures from the Teltonika wiki interface table: SIM slot, **5G LTE Cat 19** radio, and **1 x USB Type-C**, which must be supplied **5 V at 3 A** by the host - **no Ethernet port**. The power requirement is the practical detail: a 5 V / 3 A host port is not a default on industrial PCs, so a plain USB port may not bring it up. The capability list carries `wireless` only: a modem has a radio and no forwarding engine, so claiming routing, NAT or firewall here would make the simulator pretend a component is a router.
